definitions.gloss: board of directors; board of trustees; board meeting
definitions.explanation: The governing body of an organization, or a meeting of that body. Used for corporations, associations, condominiums, universities, and other organizations.

examples.japanese: {来週|らいしゅう}{理事会|りじかい}が{開|ひら}かれる。
examples.english: A board meeting will be held next week.

examples.japanese: マンションの{理事会|りじかい}に{出席|しゅっせき}した。
examples.english: I attended the condominium board meeting.

examples.japanese: {理事会|りじかい}で{新|あたら}しい{予算|よさん}{案|あん}が{承認|しょうにん}された。
examples.english: The new budget proposal was approved at the board meeting.

notes:
USAGE:
Used for governing bodies of various organizations. In Japanese condominiums ({分譲|ぶんじょう}マンション), the {理事会|りじかい} is the management board elected by unit owners. Also used for corporate boards, university governing bodies, and associations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {理事会|りじかい}を{開|ひら}く (to hold a board meeting)
- {理事会|りじかい}に{出席|しゅっせき}する (to attend a board meeting)
- {理事会|りじかい}の{決定|けってい} (board decision)
- {理事会|りじかい}{役員|やくいん} (board member)
